rv.q: The play's unconventional structure can be difficult to pull off smoothly, and Meno's cast experienced a few hiccups natural to the first outing in front of an audience, but this didn't detract from the show's overall message.
I wish I were thrilled by this remount from Ways & Means Theatre, cleverly staged at an actual American Legion Post.
Ways & Means has made an engaging first impression with What the Constitution Means to Me.
